indicator_name: Official exchange rate (LCU per US$, period average)
unit: Gambian dalasi (GMD) per 1 US dollar, annual period average of the official rate
latest_available_year_checked: mrv=3 returned 2025, 2024 and 2023; 2025 is the newest
source: World Bank, World Development Indicators (API source id 2)
fetched_with: direct HTTPS request to the World Bank API (no search tool involved)
notes: This is a yearly average of the official rate, not a daily market rate. Dalasi street or bureau rates can differ.
No EUR or GBP rate was fetched and none is invented here. Prices in gambia_tour_prices.json stay in their original currency (GMD, EUR or GBP).
To convert EUR or GBP to GMD, take a dated rate from a citable page (for example an ECB reference rate page) and record its URL and date next to the result.
